# Published compatibility fixture

Selected, unmodified adapter builds and public declarations from the MIT-licensed
`apostil@0.2.0` npm tarball, retained for offline regression tests.

Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/apostil/-/apostil-0.2.0.tgz
SHA-1: `e72aef7f705ecb05b4ed6d60968960abcb2b22fa`

The original package manifest is saved as `published-manifest.json` to check export paths. Only the files
used by these tests are copied here; this is not an installable package.
